FQHESphereHistoryCheck, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereHistoryCheck [options] 

Options:

    -d, --discard-limit : deviation before discarding a sample (default value = 1e-10)
    -s, --step-limit : maximum number of samples to be checked (default value = 0)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:

global options:
